content.title: Place an order as a guest
content.description: A visitor completes the bouquet purchase flow without creating an account, chooses a delivery date that excludes Sundays, finishes checkout as a guest, and after a successful order sees an order confirmation with an order number while Sarah receives the order by email; the source also requires this full flow to work on a phone because most customers arrive from Instagram.
content.summary: Complete guest checkout for bouquet orders
content.value: Captures orders and revenue without staff involvement while fitting one-off buyers who do not want an account.
criteria: checkout can be completed as a guest with no account required
successful orders show an order confirmation with an order number and send the order to Sarah by email
the end-to-end checkout flow works on a phone
